svg.title: Inspect the four parts of your transfer response

g.text: Inspect the four parts of your transfer response
SCIENCE → Does the model use the right quantities and units?
REASONING → Does each step follow from evidence and assumptions?
COMMUNICATION → Can another reader follow the representation?
TRANSFER → What does this predict about 2026-XJ, and what is uncertain?
Point to evidence in your own response before selecting a rubric rating.
